rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a steady drift lower from 28.98 to 28.83 with no clear reversal or momentum signal, and price sits in the upper 75% of today's range with the 9-EMA essentially flat at 28.81 — no clean directional edge. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.47%, VIXY +5.21%), which adds macro headwind uncertainty, and the 41.6 bps spread on a relatively thin tape increases the cost of being wrong. With no structural setup confirming either a continuation short or a bounce long, the risk/reward does not justify committing capital here.
